correction.title: Result corrected
correction.help: This record changed result after it was settled: it was settled again and what it said before is kept here.

cause.result_corrected: The data provider corrected the match score and this record was settled again.
cause.status_changed: The match status changed and this record was settled again.
cause.audit: A review found that the stored result did not match the match score, and it was settled again.

frozenHelp: Price and probabilities frozen when chosen: they do not change afterwards.

evaluation.title: Evaluation mode
evaluation.body: Evaluation records, built from picks of models that have not yet beaten the market. Only the administrator sees them; they are not a recommendation.

daily.title: Picks of the day
daily.subtitle: Chosen by PrediGol for {date}: they stay after kick-off and are settled when the match ends.
daily.partial_one: Only {count} selection met the criteria today. We never pad the list.
daily.partial_other: Only {count} selections met the criteria today. We never pad the list.
daily.emptyBody: We only choose selections from models that have beaten the market, without the bookmakers' margin, in their own backtest. A day without any stays empty.

reason.no_shadow_picks: No evaluation records for this day

parlay.pAllLowHelp: Product of each selection's cautious probability (the low end of the model's interval): a careful estimate, not a promise.

building.title: Looking for the parlay
building.body: Some selections pass the rules, but no combination of {min} or more grows at their cautious probability.

none.title: No parlay yet
none.body: It is built when at least {min} selections in its window pass all of PrediGol's rules.

void.title: There was no parlay this day
void.body: No combination met the criteria before the day ended.

reason.shared_team: Two selections share a team: their results are linked.
reason.measured_dependence: Correlated results: dependence measured within the same competition and day.

dependency.pending: Checking whether the selections depend on each other…

guide.how: Tap “Add to my parlay +” on a selection in:
guide.odds: The best odds for each market
guide.ruleReplace: Adding another selection from the same match replaces the previous one.
guide.noAi: The combined odds, the probability and the dependence are calculated instantly from data we already have. No AI analyses your parlay.

warning.same_competition_day_measured: Selections {legs}: same competition and day; their results are correlated (ρ {rho}).
warning.very_unlikely: All of them winning is very unlikely ({probability}).

measures.independent: No selections depend on each other.
measures.dependent: Some selections may depend on each other.

lineValue.none: None of your started picks has its closing reference yet.

lineValue.small_other: {n} picks with their closing reference: the mean shows from {min}.

lineValue.mean_other: On average {mean} against the close, over {n} picks; {positive} above zero.

recap.sampleNote_other: With {n} settled only the counts show: the charts of units appear from {min}.

funnel.label: How a pick of the day gets here
funnel.help: Each step is a filter: if no pick passes them all, the day has fewer or none. The picks of the day are chosen once PrediGol Intelligence has read the day: its pass of each match, with a news search.

noPick.honest: No match met the conditions to publish a pick today. We would rather not publish than publish for the sake of it.
noPick.reviewing: We are still going through today's matches
noPick.reviewingBody: Today's picks show here when the review is over. Meanwhile, today's matches already have their forecast and their analysis.
noPick.noMatches: There are no matches of the competitions we follow today, so there are no picks either.
noPick.reasonError: We could not load the reason.

reason.no_qualified_candidates: None of the models PrediGol publishes with had selections for today's matches.
reason.not_scheduled: The matches with selections were no longer scheduled: they had started, were postponed or suspended.
reason.too_close_to_kickoff: The selections came too close to their match's kick-off.
reason.outside_window: The matches with selections were outside the window in which we choose the picks.
reason.no_price: The selections had no odds at the bookmakers we follow.
reason.stale_price: The selections' odds were not up to date.
reason.no_consensus: The bookmakers did not agree enough on the selections' price.
reason.few_bookmakers: Too few bookmakers offered the selections.
reason.price_outlier: The selections' best odds were too far from the rest of the market.
reason.not_qualified: The selections came from models that have not beaten the market in their own backtest yet.
reason.model_retired: The selections came from a retired model.
reason.no_interval: The model had not measured the range of its probability for those selections.
reason.non_positive_ev: No market showed an edge over the market price.
reason.no_pessimistic_growth: At the cautious end of its probability, no selection made up for its risk.
reason.odds_above_cap: The selections that got that far paid odds above our risk limit: in our history, long odds lose money.
reason.day_not_ready: PrediGol Intelligence did not finish reviewing the matches' context in time.
reason.no_day_pass: PrediGol Intelligence did not finish reviewing the matches' context in time.
reason.not_reviewed: PrediGol Intelligence did not finish reviewing the matches' context in time.
reason.ai_rejected: PrediGol Intelligence turned the selections down after reviewing their matches' context.

stage.data: Today's matches did not have the data we ask for to publish.
stage.market: The market's prices did not meet our conditions.
stage.model: The models did not meet our conditions to publish.
stage.calibration: The model had not measured the range of its probability.
stage.value: No market showed an edge over the market price.
stage.risk: The selections paid odds above our risk limit.
stage.context: PrediGol Intelligence did not finish reviewing the matches' context in time.
